role: Algorithm Engineering Intern (AI, Computer Vision & Software Engineering)
jd:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Responsibilities



- Apply Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques to image transformation and defect detection.
- Analyze large-scale image datasets and evaluate algorithm performance.
- Prototype algorithms using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
- Develop production-quality software using Modern C++ and Python.
- Apply best practices in software design, testing, debugging, code reviews, and version control.
- Collaborate with algorithm, software, systems, and application engineers to deploy solutions into production.


Required Qualifications



- Strong background in Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Pattern Recognition.
- Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python.
- Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent ML frameworks.


Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with CNNs, Vision Transformers, or segmentation models.
- Experience with Modern C++ software development.
- Knowledge of image enhancement, image registration, feature extraction, or anomaly detection.
- Experience with large-scale datasets and quantitative algorithm evaluation.


What You'll Gain



- Hands-on experience in AI, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Image Processing, Modern C++, and Software Engineering.
- End-to-end exposure to algorithm development, optimization, and deployment.
- Experience building scalable, production-quality software.
- Mentorship from experts in algorithms, imaging, software engineering, and semiconductor inspection.


Minimum Qualifications

Pursuing a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Total Rewards

Base Pay Range: $58.00 - $58.00 per hour based on pursuit of a Ph.D. Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Use of AI Statement 

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

Equal Opportunity Statement

KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jd:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

With best-in-class autonomy and real-time cloud connectivity, drones are becoming critical infrastructure for solving real-world problems faster, safer, and more efficiently. Our customers, from public safety agencies to industrial and enterprise operators, rely on Skydio Cloud to plan missions, manage fleets, and make sense of the data their drones collect.

As a Software Engineering Intern, You’ll Help Build The Systems And Features That Power Autonomous Drone Operations At Scale. You’ll Work Across The Stack, From Backend Services In Python And Go To Frontend Experiences In TypeScript And React, And You’ll Own Meaningful Pieces Of Work From Idea To Shipped Feature. Our Team Works On a Wide Range Of Challenges And We Go Where We’re Needed



- Building customer-facing features in the Skydio Cloud web app, such as fleet health monitoring, media asset management, and device management
- Designing and extending the APIs and data models that connect drones, docks, and the data they produce
- Visualizing rich spatial data through maps and 3D views
- Improving the reliability, performance, and observability of the systems behind it all

The variety of work means there are plenty of opportunities to learn and have a meaningful impact on how Skydio builds and delivers software. The ideal candidate is a junior, senior, or master’s student with hands-on experience developing complex web applications, but above all, we’re looking for a highly curious and resourceful candidate, capable of using tools and AI at their disposal to accelerate their understanding and productivity.

Project Examples



- Building a system that allows product teams to manage feature flags and roll out functionality to customers, including both the backend service and the admin interface.
- Developing a new view in the web app that surfaces real-time fleet status and health for customers operating many drones and docks.
- Building tools for browsing, filtering, and managing photo and video assets captured by drones.
- Developing a test framework that allows developers to simulate vehicle states and test how the application behaves end to end.
- Profiling backend and frontend performance and optimizing how data is loaded and displayed to users.

What Makes You a Good Fit



- Solid computer science fundamentals.
- Meaningful project and/or internship experience building complex web applications, ideally touching both frontend and backend.
- Proficiency with Python, Golang, and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Experience with a modern frontend framework such as React.
- Familiarity with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL).
- Enjoys taking a feature from concept through design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

Bonus Points For



- Experience with cloud services (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) or containerized deployments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
- Experience with geospatial data, mapping, or visualization tools such as Mapbox, Cesium, PostGIS, or ThreeJS.
- Experience integrating frontend applications with real-time data systems.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Graduate students, and $58 for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience.



- For some positions the pay may be dependent upon the individual's regional location.
